W.note: Pastel aurora gradient drifts across the pill over 1.6s with a bloom halo and letter-spacing breath, genuinely ethereal, though the small dark label on pale gradient is a little soft and durations are long.

X.note: Clean, accessible dark UI with a nice lavender fill and glow in 180-480ms, but it reads as a polished glow button more than dreamlike.

Y.note: Strong contrast, proper focus mirroring and reduced-motion handling, with a pale light sweep that is pretty but brief and fairly subtle.

Z.note: Source has blurred breathing halo, pointer-following mist and 1.2-1.9s eased sweeps, very ethereal, but the hover capture missed the button, the label is small and the curve-picker demo clutters the page.
